package.name: kiss_icp_wrapper
package.description:
Thin ROS 2 LifecycleNode wrapping the upstream kiss-icp Python pipeline (PRBonn/kiss-icp). Consumes /lidar/Lidar1 (PointCloud2), runs scan-to-map point-to-point ICP with adaptive thresholding, and publishes the integrated pose on /odom_lidar (nav_msgs/Odometry). Intended as a global-anchor pose source for cone_slam to remove the cone-only DA cascade documented in docs/archive/2026-05-06_slam-phase2-cascade-frozen.md.
See issue #485 for the integration plan (Pattern A).
